column1: # slang phrases (leetspeak-style shorthand common in HK forums/social
# media), mapped to their canonical CJK spelling.
# Matched case-insensitively as a whole ASCII-alnum run (word-boundary
# gated by adjacent non-ASCII-alnum characters) BEFORE number/date
# normalization runs — otherwise a bare trailing digit like "9" gets read
# as a cardinal number before this pass ever sees it. The canonical_cjk
# spelling must already resolve correctly via rime-cantonese / ToJyutping /
# oral_hk.tsv — its reading is read verbatim from word_entries at build
# time, so it can never drift out of sync.
# on9 ("戇鳩", ngong6 gau1): common HK internet/forum leetspeak for a
# the ng- onset dropped, as is common in casual romanization) and "9"
# (gau2) substitutes for 鳩's sound rather than being read as the cardinal
